triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: yet he carried away a conviction that Dmitri Fyodorovitch could have gone nowhere but to his father’s house, and that therefore something must have happened there.

triples.subject: Fenya
triples.quote: He’ll go to Mokroe, I thought, and kill my mistress there. I ran out to beg him not to kill her.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: At five o’clock this afternoon Dmitri Fyodorovitch borrowed ten roubles from me, and I know for a fact he had no money.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: he answered that he had just received it from you, that you had given him a sum of three thousand to go to the gold-mines....

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: to talk of a man who came here, to this very drawing-room, only three hours ago, to murder me, and went stamping out of the room, as no one would go out of a decent house.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: when Dmitri Fyodorovitch had run out to look for Grushenka, he had snatched up a pestle from the mortar, and that when he returned, the pestle was not with him

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: at nine o’clock, he came to see me with a bundle of hundred-rouble notes in his hand, about two or three thousand roubles.

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: in this very place, I put the holy ikon from the relics of the holy martyr, Saint Varvara, on his neck

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: It was exactly eleven o’clock when he entered Madame Hohlakov’s house.

triples.subject: Fenya
triples.quote: Pyotr Ilyitch Perhotin, whom we left knocking at the strong locked gates of the widow Morozov’s house, ended, of course, by making himself heard.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: yet he carried away a conviction that Dmitri Fyodorovitch could have gone nowhere but to his father’s house, and that therefore something must have happened there.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “Good God! He must have killed his old father!” she cried, clasping her hands.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: with the ikon on his neck he spat at me.... He only spat, it’s true, he didn’t murder me and ... he dashed away!

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: with the ikon on his neck he spat at me.... He only spat, it’s true, he didn’t murder me and ... he dashed away!

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: I’ve never in my life lent to that unhappy man, Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov (for, in spite of all, he is unhappy), three thousand roubles to-day.
